<thought>After searching the template catalog, I obtained three suitable retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the required disconnections:

* Template 401931 – amide formation (breaks an aliphatic carboxylic acid, forms an amide).
* Template 658742 – Doebner modification (breaks an aldehyde and a second aliphatic carboxylic acid, forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic acid).
* Template 527119 – sulfonamide formation (breaks a sulfonyl‑chloride, forms a sulfonamide).
